description: 200k ohm, linear-taper, single-turn trimmer potentiometer, vertical (top) adjust, RM-065-compatible pin layout

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-09-30: exact match for PT6KV-204A2020 (Amphenol Piher), Mouser part 531-PT6KV-204A2020. A pin-compatible substitute for the circuit's Runtron RM-065 footprint - see the package evidence.

Piher PT6 datasheet ('6 mm carbon trimmer potentiometer PT6', Piher Sensing Systems, fetched 2026-09-30 via pk-components.de mirror - piher.net itself returned HTTP 403 in this environment), page 2 'How to order' resistance table: code '204' = 200,000 ohm (200K). The part number's value field, PT6KV-204A2020, is this code. (Mouser's own description text for this SKU is generic - 'Trimmer Resistors - Through Hole 6mm trimmer potentiometer tht' - and does not itself restate the value, so the manufacturer's ordering-code table is the evidence used here.)
Piher PT6 datasheet, page 2 'How to order' diagram: Taper field 'A = Lin.' (B = Log., C = Alog.). PT6KV-204A2020's taper field is 'A', i.e. linear.

Runtron RM-065 datasheet (runtron.com's own document - letterhead, logo and 'Http://www.runtron.com' footer throughout; fetched 2026-09-30 via soldered.com mirror since runtron.com itself returned HTTP 404 in this environment), 'OUTLINE DIMENSIONS' drawing: 3 pins, each hole 1.0mm(+0.2/-0.0) dia; pins 1 and 3 are 5mm apart in a line, pin 2 is centered and offset 5mm perpendicular from that line (an isosceles triangle, base 5mm, height 5mm). Confirmed against the repository's own KiCad footprint file (Potentiometer_THT.pretty/Potentiometer_Runtron_RM-065_Vertical.kicad_mod), whose pads sit at (0,0), (5,0) and (2.5,5) mm with 1.0mm drills - the same triangle.

Piher PT6 datasheet, page 3 'V = horizontal mounting - vertical adjustment' PCB pad drawing: 2 pins 0.9mm(+0.1) dia spaced 2.5mm + 2.5mm (5mm total) apart, and a third 0.9mm(+0.1) dia pin centered on that line's midpoint and offset 2.5mm + 2.5mm (5mm total) perpendicular from it - the same isosceles triangle (base 5mm, height 5mm, apex centered) as the Runtron RM-065 drawing above. Mouser does not carry Runtron (bun run parts search RM-065 / search Runtron --supplier mouser returned no matching trimmer); Bourns's 3306 series (also in stock at Mouser) was checked and rejected - its own 3306 datasheet (bourns.com/docs/Product-Datasheets/3306.pdf) 'SUGGESTED PWB LAYOUT - STYLES K, P, W' drawing shows a shallower triangle (base 5mm, height 2.5mm, not 5mm), which does not match the RM-065 drawing.

why: The circuit models this line as Runtron's RM-065, but Mouser does not carry Runtron, so mpn records the modeled part while the part actually bought is Piher's. Same family choice as trimmer-1k-linear-rm065 (see that entry for the full Runtron/Bourns/Piher comparison): Piher's PT6 'V' style pin pattern matches the Runtron RM-065's own drawing exactly, and Bourns's 3306 (the other in-stock candidate) does not. PT6KV-204A2020 is the same linear-taper, vertical-adjust, cross-slot-rotor part at the 200K value, in stock at Mouser under the Amphenol Piher brand.
